title: Unlisted debenture held 3 years, redeemed at a premium on 10-Jan-2025: s.50AA (as amended w.e.f. 23-Jul-2024) deems the gain short-term at slab regardless of holding period
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.50AA as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024 w.e.f. 23-Jul-2024: capital gain on transfer, redemption or maturity of an unlisted bond or unlisted debenture (on or after 23-Jul-2024) is deemed to arise from a short-term capital asset, whatever the period of holding and whatever the date of acquisition
Gain = full value of consideration on redemption - cost of acquisition - transfer expenses; no indexation
Without s.50AA the debenture (36 months > 24, unlisted) would be long-term at 12.5 %: tax 125.00 - s.50AA overrides this
STCG on a non-STT asset taxed at normal slab rates (30 % given)
derivation: Unlisted debenture redeemed after 23-Jul-2024 -> s.50AA: deemed short-term, slab (held 36 months is irrelevant).
Note: some treat a redemption premium as interest (income from other sources); tax at slab would be the same 300.00.
